anomalies.observed: The EN pin of the TPS62933 buck regulator (U6 pin 2) is marked as no_connect and is not connected to any net.
anomalies.expected: The EN pin should be tied to VIN (+24V) or to a UVLO resistor divider to enable the regulator.
anomalies.impact: The 5V rail may never turn on, leaving the entire board without power.

anomalies.observed: FLOAT_LOW (NET0038) drives the base of NPN T7 via R19. When FLOAT_LOW is high (normal water level), T7 turns on and pulls the main pump MOSFET T1 gate (/NET0061) low, disabling the pump. When FLOAT_LOW is low (water low), T7 turns off, allowing T1 to be driven on by IO10.
anomalies.expected: The low-level float switch should cut off the main pump when water is low. Thus, when FLOAT_LOW is low, the pump should be disabled, not enabled.

evidence.quote: float-switch interlocks for low-level pump cutoff

anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump will run when the water level is low, risking dry running and pump damage. It will be off when water level is normal.

anomalies.observed: C71 (100n) is connected between the FLOAT_HIGH input (NET0095) and the +3V3 rail.
anomalies.expected: A filter capacitor on a switch input should be connected to GND, not to a supply rail.
anomalies.impact: Noise on the float switch input will be coupled onto the 3.3V supply, potentially causing false high-level readings and erratic ATO valve behavior.
